rationale: The chemoreflex set-point effect on ventilatory drive is a specialized case of homeostatic feedback: a regulated variable (CO2/pH) is compared with a set point, and the effector (drive to breathe) is adjusted accordingly. Raising the set point dampens the drive, exactly as homeostatic theory predicts for a shifted reference value.
